title: Fully printed organic thin-film transistors: pathways to scalable, high-performance flexible electronics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,567-604
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00920K, Tutorial Review
Shengyu Yu, Wei Deng, Xianshuo Wu, Yiwen Ren, Yidi Xie, Simin Sun, Lingjie Sun, Fangxu Yang, Hao-Li Zhang, Wenping Hu
This tutorial review introduces the fundamental principles, core materials, interfacial engineering, and key technologies/strategies for achieving fully printed organic electronics with high performance and high functional density.
